definition: Brief social or conversational content without a specific request, progress claim or concrete strategy signal in this coding.
A statement about an approach to trying the challenge; effectiveness is not verified.
A self-reported challenge goal or current progress; completion and team membership are not verified.
An invitation to collaborate; it does not establish actual team membership.
A visible image message whose content is not classified; no image-content inference is made.
An explicit request for a leaderboard or leaderboard update.
A request about registration, scheduling, submission access or other participation logistics; no organizer role is inferred.
A question or explanation about challenge rules or deliverable requirements; author authority is not implied.
Readable message content outside the specific categories; unverified numerical claims remain text claims, not measured participation.
An explicit self-report in response to a participation prompt. Pseudonymous reported team labels are scoped to that channel collection; neither membership nor entry is verified.
An explicit request for assistance or resources. Message presence does not establish whether the issue was later resolved.
A request for other participants to share scores. The question itself does not verify scores or request an official leaderboard.
